name: Unshipped order review
summary: The fulfilment or customer-service lead gets one aged list of the orders not yet sent, whole or in part: how old each is, what is holding it, who owns the next step, and which orders have none. Nothing is released, moved or sent.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of supply chain and inventory work: order, order-line and hold exports with set column headers that stop on a mismatch; shipped state worked out from the lines, never from a status word; age in calendar days in four bands with the oldest first; holds kept in force until a person releases them; a next step counts only with an owner; a youngest-band grace for orders with no hold; part-shipped orders checked for days since the last shipment; and a question for the fulfilment lead on each order that needs a decision.
